Name: Seasonal Younger Wizard in talkohlooeys' Style
Author: orangerin
Description:
introducing a younger wizard; now in seasonal variant! this mod contains pngs for both talkohlooey's ponytail wizard along with a short-haired version of him, which i edited from the ponytail one. there's also SVE compatible portraits for both :) huge creds to talkohlooeys since im just editing their younger wizard to fit the seasonal cheers

[color=#ff0000][b]!!important!![/b][/color]
this is a portrait replacer meant to be used with another mod;
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1onexs and talkohlooeys' seasonal portrait[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]werewolfmaster's romanceable rasmodius[/url] (optional)

drop this in your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits\assets\Portraits\Wizard[/b] folder and replace the portraits there.
dont forget to edit your romanceable rasmodius config; make sure the [i]portrait[/i] is set to 'custom' so that the portrait loads properly

for SVE;
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11523/]1onexs and talkohlooeys' sve seasonal portrait[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]paintedparrots's sve compatible romanceable rasmodius[/url] (optional)

drop this in your just drop this in your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys SVE Seasonal Portraits\assets\Portraits\Magnus[/b] folder and replace the portraits there
dont forget to edit your sve romanceable rasmodius config if you have it; make sure the [i]custom wizard[/i] is set to 'true' so that the portrait loads properly

you guys will have to replace the portraits everytime the other mods update, sorry about that! maybe one of these day i'll finally learn how to do a proper cp mod @-@

recommended mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10555]mothbeanie's seasonal younger wizard [/url](im using the sprites in this one for my game, even if theyre not really the same as my portrait. i just think theyre neat)

Downloads.Description: A 7 expression wizard, made to fit SVE.
